children: may retest a support at $98.80 per barrel, a break below which could open the way towards $96.91.
The market is riding on a wave c from $104.91, which has briefly travelled below its 61.8% projection level of $99.96. It has a better chance of extending to the 100% level of $96.91.
A confirmed bearish pennant suggests a similar target. Immediate resistance is at $100.91, a break above which may lead to a gain limited to $101.85.
